expected_findings.description: Test wraps the result in `sorted()` before comparing, checking only membership not order, when the documented contract is that `declared_web_tools` returns a sorted list.
Function accesses `agent_def.tools` directly instead of routing through `declared_web_tools`, making it inconsistent with other functions and unable to inherit filtering logic if it grows.
Uses partial matching for the type string with `startswith()`, which could pass a typo, though this is an acceptable trade-off given the VERIFY annotation.
